visual_action: A slideshow of still photographs depicts a dignified transfer ceremony on an airport tarmac. Donald Trump, wearing a dark overcoat, stands by a black SUV and salutes as uniformed soldiers carry a flag-draped casket. Other images show various military personnel in different uniforms standing in formation, and a shot from behind Trump and others as they look toward the open cargo bay of a military transport plane.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is visually identifiable in several still photos, where he is shown saluting a casket and presiding over a military ceremony.

central_claim: Donald Trump respectfully honors the sacrifice of fallen American service members.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of respect, solemnity, and patriotism, and to view Donald Trump as a reverent Commander-in-Chief.
